import axios from"axios";// Get the current host dynamically
const getBaseURL=()=>{const hostname=window.location.hostname;const protocol=window.location.protocol;// If accessing from mobile device, use the current hostname
if(hostname==='localhost'||hostname==='127.0.0.1'){return"".concat(protocol,"//").concat(hostname,":8080/api");}// For mobile access via IP or ngrok
return"".concat(protocol,"//").concat(hostname,":8080/api");};const api=axios.create({baseURL:getBaseURL(),headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"}});// Attach JWT automatically
api.interceptors.request.use(config=>{const token=localStorage.getItem("token");if(token){config.headers.Authorization="Bearer ".concat(token);}return config;});export default api;
